title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Getting to the core (class # 24)

chapters.title: Granddaughter's birth and the soul as a song
Making decisions and uncovering inner voices
chapters.about: decision making, fears, onion peel layers

chapters.title: Clearing static and connecting to Hashem's voice
Moving from the material world to spiritual value
Equal values in mitzvot and choosing life
chapters.about: Torah authority, kibbud horim, choosing life

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to quiet inner static and connect with one's pure core intentions when making decisions. She explores how moving beyond the physical world's perspective of gain and loss allows a person to view all actions and mitzvot as equally valuable connections to Hashem.
questions: How can I stop second-guessing my decisions and make choices with peace of mind?
Why do I feel so conflicted and overwhelmed when faced with daily choices?
How do our pure intentions get covered up by layers of habits and criticism?
How can I view different responsibilities, like caring for aging parents versus taking time for myself, without feeling guilty?
